_doc: Test fixtures for plan-doc-gate.mjs PreToolUse hook (issue #105, enforcing #104 at runtime). Each fixture is a Claude Code hook input JSON object piped to the hook on stdin. Hook contract: ALWAYS exits 0; the decision is communicated via stdout JSON, both as hookSpecificOutput.{permissionDecision,permissionDecisionReason} and as a flat top-level mirror. Non-zero exit indicates a hook bug — see #133, where a non-zero exit with empty stdout made the sibling hook fail OPEN.
_classification_doc: The gate is PATH-BASED ONLY. It never reads the target file and never inspects tool_input.content / new_string / old_string, so nothing is blocked for 'looking like a plan' (fixtures 30-31 prove this). Order of evaluation: (1) tool must be Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit; (2) target must end in .md/.markdown/.txt; (3) maintained-doc basename allowlist (CLAUDE.md, agent.md, README.md, SKILL.md, SHARED_TASK_NOTES.md, ...); (4) allowlisted directory segments (tests, __tests__, fixtures, templates, dist, node_modules, .git, vendor); (5) deny set — any file under a .claude/plans/ directory, or a basename stem that is exactly plan|plans|prompt|prompts|scratch|scratchpad, or ends in -plan/_plan, or starts with issue<digits>.
_known_gap: A Bash write (`cat > plan.md <<EOF`) is NOT gated: this hook is registered on the write TOOLS only. Gating Bash would require inspecting redirect targets inside arbitrary shell, which is the content/shape heuristic that cost the sibling hook four review rounds. The CI check from #104 remains the broad layer.
_parity_doc: TRIPWIRE, NOT A GUARANTEE OF EQUIVALENCE. dist/plan-doc-gate.mjs is a HAND-MAINTAINED artifact — this repo has no package.json, no tsc and no build step, so nothing regenerates it from my/hooks/plan-doc-gate.ts. These sha256 sums pin both files so neither can be edited without the other, which catches ACCIDENTAL drift only: anyone who edits both files and re-pins both hashes passes regardless of whether the two behave the same. Only the .mjs is ever executed. After changing either file, run: sha256sum my/hooks/plan-doc-gate.ts dist/plan-doc-gate.mjs and update _parity below.
